card.title: Obey Without Explanation
card.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring that empty box to my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring that empty box to my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

mechanism: A gives purposeless carrying orders and then adds silent reversal to test obedience.
confusable: Unlike assigning useful work, the requests must make acceptance of A's authority their own purpose.
comparison: D59-a makes a completed delivery return without questions; D59-b expands a cold-window test into fetching and holding A's coat.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
